subject.title: Feature: Support custom anthropic_beta flags in Bedrock model config

question: Should Bedrock expose a broad `additionalModelRequestFields` or `providerFields` merge contract, a narrower typed `anthropicBeta` or `context1m` option, or keep Anthropic beta flags internal?
rationale: The missing path is source-proven, but adding provider request-body config expands a public provider contract and repository policy sets a high bar for new config surface.

options.title: Add Bedrock request-field merge contract
options.body: Expose a Bedrock-owned, schema-validated merge point for vendor request fields and document precedence and `anthropic_beta` dedup semantics.

options.title: Add only a narrow beta option
options.body: Support a typed `anthropicBeta` or 1M-context option while avoiding a broad arbitrary request-field passthrough.

options.title: Decline custom beta config
options.body: Keep beta flags internal and require users to wait for first-class provider support instead of sending custom vendor request fields.

recommendation.title: Add Bedrock request-field merge contract
recommendation.body: Expose a Bedrock-owned, schema-validated merge point for vendor request fields and document precedence and `anthropic_beta` dedup semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent has the strongest recent history on Bedrock request shaping and model-support behavior in the affected files.
